#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;

long long x, y, n;

long long computeGCD(long long a, long long b) {
    while (b != 0) {
        long long temp = b;
        b = a % b;
        a = temp;
    }
    return a;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    if (y <= n) {
        long long g = computeGCD(x, y);
        x /= g;
        y /= g;
        cout << x << "/" << y;
        return 0;
    }

    if (x == y) {
        cout << "1/1";
        return 0;
    }

    double target = static_cast<double>(x) / y;
    double minDiff = 1e18;
    long long bestNum = 0, bestDen = 1;

    for (long long d = 1; d <= n; ++d) {
        long long num = static_cast<long long>(round(target * d));
        if (num < 0) num = 0;
        double diff = abs(target - static_cast<double>(num) / d);
        if (diff < minDiff) {
            minDiff = diff;
            bestNum = num;
            bestDen = d;
        }
    }

    long long g = computeGCD(bestNum, bestDen);
    bestNum /= g;
    bestDen /= g;

    cout << bestNum << "/" << bestDen;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <limits>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

ll x, y, n;

ll gcd(ll a, ll b) {
    if (b == 0) return a;
    return gcd(b, a % b);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);

    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    if (y <= n) {
        ll g = gcd(x, y);
        cout << x/g << "/" << y/g;
        return 0;
    }

    if (x == y) {
        cout << "1/1";
        return 0;
    }

    double target = (double)x / y;
    double bestError = numeric_limits<double>::max();
    ll bestNum = 0, bestDen = 1;

    for (ll den = 1; den <= n; ++den) {
        ll num = (ll)floor(target * den + 0.5);
        double error = abs(target - (double)num / den);
        if (error < bestError) {
            bestError = error;
            bestNum = num;
            bestDen = den;
        }
    }

    ll g = gcd(bestNum, bestDen);
    bestNum /= g;
    bestDen /= g;

    cout << bestNum << "/" << bestDen;
    return 0;
}
